user.title: Weather Plus
user.description: Wraps a weather entity's hourly forecast and exposes morningtime/daytime/nighttime high/low sensors.

data_description.daytime_mode: Fixed hours use the values below; Sun mode uses dawn / noon / dusk from Home Assistant's sun entity.
data_description.enable_conditions: Adds binary sensors like today_rain, today_cold, hour_lightning derived from the hourly forecast.
data_description.rain_rate_entity: Optional gauge (e.g. sensor.gw1200_rainrate). Any reading > 0 forces hour_rainy on, catching drizzle the forecast misses.
data_description.rain_daily_entity: Optional gauge (e.g. sensor.gw1200_dailyrain). Any reading > 0 forces today_rain on.

user.title: Add activity
user.description: Staged search for the best moment to go outside. Pass 1 bounds the search to the daily time window (e.g. morning walk = 6 to 9). Pass 2 keeps moments inside the temperature range. Pass 3 keeps moments at or below the sun elevation cap. Each pass rolls back if it would leave nothing, and the winner is the moment closest to the ideal temperature.

data_description.use_temperature: Keep only moments whose temperature stays within the range below for the next 20 minutes. Rolled back if nothing qualifies.
data_description.use_elevation: Keep only moments whose sun elevation stays at or below the cap for the next 20 minutes. Rolled back to the temperature pass if nothing qualifies.
data_description.max_elevation: Degrees above the horizon. Lower means softer light: 15 keeps a walk in the low morning or late evening sun.
